matching_pages_notes: Original NARA PDF pages 65 through 74 were rendered at 180 dpi and all 322 previously unaudited printed rows on pages 65-68, 71, and 73-74 were compared with immutable source records for row order, indexed spelling and initials, suffixes, rank or grade, private-identifier column occupancy, box, notes, and archive location. Pages 69, 70, and 72 had already passed visual review; all 460 rows across the ten-page block agree with the current extraction. Literal source anomalies remain unchanged, including Benjamine, Santro, Caldarea, Maragaret, Calvocressi, Clayde, Campbell. with its printed period, Allissandrina, Capt in the surname column, Stravros, Carini with Maj in the middle-initial column, French notes, Carmain Harold with Keith in the middle field, Carmain Howard with Edwin in the middle field and the note also as, Carrazo, Jeffery, Pellagrino, Carrolll, the nine-digit William L Carter number, Rail, Emileo, Casademont with the note possible, Casasres Migule, Catacuzenne, Denbnis, and Katehrine. Private identifiers are not included in this review bundle or public assets.
